# Flenix Jewels Ltd

> Flenix Jewels Ltd is a premium fine jewelry brand established in 2015, specialising in certified lab-grown diamonds, natural diamonds, and bespoke gold jewelry. We serve customers in 15+ countries with GIA- and IGI-certified pieces, worldwide free insured shipping, and lifetime guarantees.

## About Us

Flenix Jewels Ltd was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India — the world capital of diamond polishing. We also serve clients from our East Rutherford, NJ, USA office. Our expertise lies in crafting fine diamond jewelry using both lab-grown (CVD and HPHT) and natural mined diamonds set in 14KT and 18KT gold, white gold, rose gold, and platinum.

We are trusted by 1,000+ happy clients across USA, Canada, Australia, Germany, UK, and India. Aggregate rating: 4.9/5 from 1,250+ verified reviews.

## Certifications & Partnerships

- **GIA** (Gemological Institute of America) — Certified natural and lab-grown diamonds
- **IGI** (International Gemological Institute) — Certified lab-grown and natural diamonds
- **Rapaport** — Diamond pricing and market data partner
- **VDB** (Virtual Diamond Boutique) — Diamond technology partner

## Product Categories

- [Diamond Rings](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/rings): Engagement rings, eternity rings, solitaire rings, halo rings, three-stone rings in lab-grown and natural diamonds
- [Diamond Necklaces](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/necklaces): Pendants, tennis necklaces, solitaire necklaces, layering necklaces, diamond drops
- [Diamond Earrings](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/earrings): Studs, hoops, drop earrings, chandelier earrings, huggie earrings
- [Diamond Bracelets](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/bracelets): Tennis bracelets, bangles, cuff bracelets, charm bracelets
- [Wedding Bands](https://www.flenixjewels.com/category/wedding-bands): His and hers wedding bands, stackable rings, eternity bands
- [All Categories](https://www.flenixjewels.com/categories): Full product catalog

## Diamond Catalog

- [Diamond Search](https://www.flenixjewels.com/diamond): Browse certified natural and lab-grown loose diamonds with advanced filters — shape, carat, cut, color, clarity, certificate type (GIA/IGI), and price range.
- Diamond shapes: Round Brilliant, Princess, Oval, Cushion, Emerald, Pear, Marquise, Radiant, Asscher, Heart
- Diamond quality: FL to SI2 clarity, D-Z color, Excellent to Good cut grades

## Key Features & Policies

- **Certifications**: GIA and IGI certified diamonds on all major pieces
- **Diamond Types**: Lab-grown (CVD, HPHT) and natural (mined, conflict-free, ethical) diamonds
- **Metal Options**: 14KT and 18KT yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, and platinum
- **Custom Design**: Bespoke jewelry design and manufacturing — engagement rings, wedding bands, and all jewelry types
- **Worldwide Shipping**: Free insured express shipping to USA, Canada, Australia, Germany, UK, India, and 15+ countries
- **Delivery Time**: 5–14 business days depending on destination
- **Returns**: 30-day return policy, free return shipping
- **Lifetime Guarantee**: All certified pieces include a lifetime quality guarantee
- **Luxury Packaging**: Complimentary gift packaging on orders over $500
- **Contact**: WhatsApp +852 51254000 | Email info@flenixjewels.com
